# Engineering Knowledge Base

> A reusable software engineering knowledge base for humans and AI-assisted engineering systems.

## Purpose

The Engineering Knowledge Base (EKB) defines what good software engineering means.

It provides reusable engineering knowledge that can be referenced by engineering frameworks, AI assistants, and software projects.

EKB answers:

> What does good engineering look like?
